metadata.description: Global food additives and ingredient regulatory knowledge base documenting international status across India (FSSAI), European Union (EFSA), and United States (US FDA).

primary_sources.authority: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
primary_sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011
European Union Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 on food additives
Food Additive Status List & Generally Recognized as Safe (GRAS) Notices
Diet, nutrition and the prevention of chronic diseases / Saturated fatty acid intake

171.fssai_notes: Permitted in specified food categories under FSSAI regulations.
171.eu_efsa_notes: Banned in the European Union since 2022 (Regulation EU 2022/63) because genotoxicity and accumulation of nanoparticles could not be ruled out.
171.us_fda_notes: Permitted up to 1% by weight in food under 21 CFR 73.575.
171.health_concern: Potential nanoparticle accumulation and DNA damage (genotoxicity concerns identified by EFSA).
171.plain_english: Titanium Dioxide (INS 171) is banned in the European Union because EFSA concluded it can no longer be considered safe due to potential genotoxicity risks.
171.hindi_explanation: टाइटेनियम डाइऑक्साइड (INS 171) को यूरोपीय संघ (EU) में 2022 से पूरी तरह बैन कर दिया गया है क्योंकि इसके नैनोकण डीएनए को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं।

924a.fssai_notes: Banned by FSSAI in India in 2016 for use in bread and bakery products.
924a.us_fda_notes: Not banned outright, but FDA urges bakers to voluntarily cease use.
924a.health_concern: Classified as a possible human carcinogen (IARC Group 2B); kidney and thyroid toxicity in animal studies.
924a.plain_english: Potassium Bromate is banned in India and the European Union due to recognized carcinogenic risks.
924a.hindi_explanation: पोटेशियम ब्रोमेट भारत (FSSAI) और यूरोप में पूरी तरह प्रतिबंधित है क्योंकि यह संभावित कैंसरकारी एजेंट है।

927a.fssai_notes: Permitted with strict maximum limits in flour.
927a.eu_efsa_notes: Banned in the European Union as a food additive since 2005.
927a.us_fda_notes: Permitted up to 45 ppm under 21 CFR 172.806.
927a.health_concern: Thermal breakdown produces semicarbazide and ethyl carbamate; respiratory sensitivity.
927a.plain_english: Azodicarbonamide is banned in the European Union and Australia as a food additive.
927a.hindi_explanation: एज़ोडाइकार्बोनामाइड यूरोप और ऑस्ट्रेलिया में खाद्य एडिटिव के रूप में बैन है।

102.fssai_notes: Permitted in specified foods up to 100 ppm with mandatory label declaration.
102.eu_efsa_notes: Permitted, but requires mandatory warning: 'May have an adverse effect on activity and attention in children' (Southampton study warning).
102.us_fda_notes: Requires specific label naming as FD&C Yellow No. 5 due to allergic intolerance in sensitive individuals.
102.health_concern: Associated with hyperactivity in children (Southampton study) and urticaria/asthma flare-ups in aspirin-sensitive individuals.
102.plain_english: Tartrazine (INS 102) is restricted in Europe and requires a warning label stating it may impair activity and attention in children.
102.hindi_explanation: टार्ट्राज़िन (INS 102) सिंथेटिक पीला रंग है। यूरोप में इस पर बच्चों में अतिसक्रियता (Hyperactivity) की चेतावनी लिखना अनिवार्य है।

110.fssai_notes: Permitted up to 100 ppm in specified foods with mandatory declaration.
110.eu_efsa_notes: Mandatory warning required regarding adverse effects on child attention.
110.health_concern: Azo dye sensitivity; linked to hyperactivity in children.
110.plain_english: Sunset Yellow (INS 110) requires a child hyperactivity warning on packaging in the European Union.
110.hindi_explanation: सनसेट येलो (INS 110) पर भी यूरोप में बच्चों के मानसिक ध्यान पर असर की चेतावनी आवश्यक है।

551.fssai_notes: Permitted in powders and seasonings up to 2.0% under GMP.
551.eu_efsa_notes: Permitted in EU, but EFSA re-evaluation highlighted need to characterize nanoscale particle distribution.
551.us_fda_notes: Permitted up to 2% by weight in food under 21 CFR 172.480.
551.health_concern: Generally inert anti-caking agent; nanoscale scrutiny ongoing regarding intestinal absorption.
551.plain_english: Silicon Dioxide (INS 551) is a permitted anti-caking agent in India, the US, and EU, used to prevent powders from clumping.
551.hindi_explanation: सिलिकॉन डाइऑक्साइड (INS 551) पाउडर को जमने से रोकने वाला एंटी-केकिंग एजेंट है, जो भारत और विदेश में अनुमत है।

330.fssai_notes: Permitted in foods under Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
330.eu_efsa_notes: Permitted as E330 without upper numerical safety limits.
330.health_concern: High acidity; frequent exposure in snacks/drinks can contribute to dental enamel erosion.
330.plain_english: Citric Acid (INS 330) is widely permitted globally as a natural acidity regulator. Frequent high intake can erode dental enamel.
330.hindi_explanation: साइट्रिक एसिड (INS 330) वैश्विक स्तर पर सुरक्षित और अनुमत एसिडिटी रेगुलेटर है, लेकिन अत्यधिक खट्टापन दांतों के इनेमल को कमजोर कर सकता है।

334.fssai_notes: Permitted under GMP in specified confectionery and snack categories.
334.eu_efsa_notes: Permitted as E334 with an Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI) of 240 mg/kg body weight.
334.us_fda_notes: Generally Recognized as Safe under 21 CFR 184.1099.
334.health_concern: Strong organic acid. Reacts with metallic cookware (copper, brass, nickel, silver) to form toxic metal salts.
334.plain_english: Tartaric Acid (INS 334) is an organic acid. Important packaging note: Never prepare or store in brass or copper utensils because acid forms toxic chemical salts.
334.hindi_explanation: टार्टरिक एसिड (INS 334) इमली का मुख्य एसिड है। इसे तांबे या पीतल के बर्तनों में कभी नहीं रखना चाहिए क्योंकि यह जहरीले कॉपर सॉल्ट बनाता है।

500(ii).fssai_notes: Permitted under GMP in bakery, batters, and pellets.
500(ii).us_fda_notes: Generally Recognized as Safe under 21 CFR 184.1736.
500(ii).health_concern: Contains sodium; adds to total dietary sodium intake.
500(ii).plain_english: Sodium Bicarbonate (INS 500(ii)) is baking soda, permitted globally as a safe raising agent.
500(ii).hindi_explanation: सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट (INS 500(ii)) सामान्य मीठा सोडा है जो तलने और फुलाने के लिए सुरक्षित और विश्वभर में अनुमत है।

621.fssai_notes: Permitted in specified foods; prohibited in infant foods; requires mandatory label declaration.
621.eu_efsa_notes: Permitted with a group ADI of 30 mg/kg body weight per day.
621.us_fda_notes: Generally Recognized as Safe, but requires specific ingredient listing.
621.health_concern: Glutamate sensitivity in a subset of individuals (headache, flushing); prohibited in infant nutrition.
621.plain_english: Monosodium Glutamate (MSG / INS 621) is permitted with specific limits and mandatory labeling. Prohibited in baby foods.
621.hindi_explanation: एमएसजी (INS 621) स्वाद बढ़ाने वाला पदार्थ है जो वयस्कों के लिए अनुमत है लेकिन शिशु आहार में पूरी तरह प्रतिबंधित है।

palmolein_oil.health_summary: High in saturated fatty acids (~45-50% palmitic acid), which raises serum LDL cholesterol and cardiovascular risk.
palmolein_oil.plain_english: Contains Refined Palmolein Oil, which is approximately 50% saturated fat. High intake of saturated fats raises LDL (bad) cholesterol and increases cardiovascular risk.
palmolein_oil.hindi_explanation: इसमें पामोलिन तेल है जिसमें लगभग 50% सैचुरेटेड फैट होता है। इसका अधिक सेवन खराब कोलेस्ट्रॉल (LDL) और दिल की बीमारियों का खतरा बढ़ाता है।
palmolein_oil.authority: WHO (World Health Organization) / ICMR-NIN (National Institute of Nutrition India)

maida.health_summary: Stripped of bran and germ; low in dietary fiber with a high glycemic index, causing rapid postprandial blood sugar spikes.
maida.plain_english: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida) has had its fiber-rich bran removed. It digests rapidly and has a high glycemic index.
maida.hindi_explanation: मैदा (रिफाइंड गेहूं का आटा) में फाइबर नहीं होता और इसका ग्लाइसेमिक इंडेक्स ऊंचा होता है, जिससे ब्लड शुगर तेजी से बढ़ता है।

sugar.health_summary: High free sugar intake contributes to dental caries, weight gain, insulin resistance, and increased type 2 diabetes risk.
sugar.plain_english: High added sugar content. WHO recommends keeping free sugars below 10% (ideally below 5%) of total daily energy intake.
sugar.hindi_explanation: अतिरिक्त चीनी का अधिक सेवन वजन बढ़ने, दांतों में सड़न और इंसुलिन प्रतिरोध का कारण बनता है।
sugar.authority: WHO Guideline: Sugars intake for adults and children

gluten_wheat.health_summary: Contains gluten proteins. Must be strictly avoided by individuals with Coeliac Disease or Wheat Allergy.
gluten_wheat.plain_english: Contains gluten from wheat. Induces autoimmune mucosal damage in Coeliac Disease and allergic reactions in wheat-allergic individuals.
gluten_wheat.hindi_explanation: इसमें गेहूं का ग्लूटेन है। सीलिएक रोग और गेहूं एलर्जी वाले व्यक्तियों को इससे पूरी तरह बचना चाहिए।
gluten_wheat.authority: FSSAI Mandatory Allergen Schedule II / NIDDK

acidic_metal_reaction.health_summary: Organic food acids (tartaric, citric) chemically leach copper and zinc from brass/copper/silver vessels, forming toxic metal salts.
acidic_metal_reaction.plain_english: PACKAGING SAFETY CAUTION: Do not use brass, copper, nickel, or silver utensils with this product. Acids from tamarind and tartaric acid react with metal to form toxic verdigris salts.
acidic_metal_reaction.hindi_explanation: सावधानी: इस उत्पाद को तांबे, पीतल या चांदी के बर्तनों में न बनाएं और न रखें। खट्टे एसिड तांबे से क्रिया करके जहरीले लवण बनाते हैं।
acidic_metal_reaction.authority: FSSAI Food Safety Standards & Manufacturer Label Advisory
